lines.trans: Hold on, is that not Cindy? Cindy never used to do shows like that—lately she seems to be appearing on everything!
Hello everyone—yes, our Jinny is a junior with tremendous vocal talent.
That right there is CEO Byun's textbook tactic—she pulled the exact same move years ago.
What was that singer's name again? Oh gosh, I barely even recall her name now, when she used to be huge!
Yuna. Tie-in bundling—back then Byun fronted Yuna at her peak to bundle her rookie group onto every show.
Ahead of contract renewal, draining every drop of sweetness to launch a favored rookie and mercilessly discarding the star once useless—that is CEO Byun.
Surely she would not pull that on Cindy too? Cindy is the top of the top right now—unless CEO Byun has lost her mind!
By the way, what nerve made Yuna defy CEO Byun like that back then? Were you not pretty close with her?
I am tired—heading to bed.
